root_cause.text: The error handling path in `airoha_qdma_rx_process()` conditionally skipped releasing the current page fragment back to the page pool if `q->skb` was allocated, which caused a memory leak when an error occurred before the fragment could be linked to the socket buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `page_pool_put_full_page(q->page_pool, page, true)` was previously placed inside an `else` block and only executed when `q->skb` was NULL, but is now executed unconditionally in the error path to ensure the unlinked page is always returned to the pool.

intent_record.how: This ensures that the allocated page is always released back to the page pool, even when the socket buffer (skb) is present and freed, preventing a memory leak.
